notes.title: Fixed Humphreys missing star in Chancellorsville
notes.notes: Thanks for dhalect, a missing star for Humphreys was found in the Chancellorsville scenario.  This patch should correct that mistake.

notes.title: Fix for Fredericksburg solitaire scenario AI bug
notes.notes: This patch fixes an issue in the Fredericksburg solitaire AI bot that causes it to fail to recognize when returning blown units don't have any valid destination hexes.

notes.title: Typo correction and fix for possible detachment lockup
notes.notes: This patch fixes a typo in the scenario instructions, and fixes an issue where a detachment could be legally placed next to an empty fort, but if your opponent moved a unit into the fort, the detachment would be required to conduct a mandatory attack.  Detachments cannot attack, however, and the game would be stuck at that point.  The fix checks at the start of each attack phase to see if there are any detachments with mandatory attacks, and if there are, they are recalled and a message explaining why is displayed to the player(s).

notes.title: Fix missing road connection
notes.notes: This small patch fixes a missing road connection on the Chickamauga/Chattanooga maps

notes.title: AI patch for CSA Wilderness
notes.notes: This patch fixes an issue where the Confederate AI could freeze in the Wilderness scenario if reinforcements had limited paths out of their entry hex.

notes.title: Patch for AI bug after removing pontoon bridge
notes.notes: This patch fixes an issue in which the AI could get stuck after successfully removing a pontoon bridge in the Wilderness scenario.

notes.title: Fix for Tutorial 3 on some Macs
notes.notes: This update fixes a potential issue with running the third tutorial on some Macs.

notes.title: Addition of hotkeys to gameplay
notes.notes: This update adds 2 hotkeys to gameplay: spacebar will now click the "End Move", "Done", or similar confirmation button in the game prompt area, and pressing "V" will toggle units visibility on/off as if the button near the minimap was pressed.

notes.title: Fix for missing opponent move highlight if playing as Confederates
notes.notes: This update fixes a bug wherein a player playing as the Confederates would only briefly see the highlighted hexes of the AI's moves.

notes.title: Bug fix for achievements
notes.notes: Fixes an issue wherein a user might receive an achievement they hadn't actually completed.
